text: 離散非線形写像の独立Jacobian・JVP・VJP Independent Jacobians, JVPs and VJPs of discrete nonlinear maps 離散非線形写像の独立Jacobian・JVP・VJP Jv=Df(x)v,\quad \operatorname{VJP}(w)=J^\top w,\quad (Jv)^\top G_yw=v^\top G_x(G_x^{-1}J^\top G_yw). 固定R4→R3写像は重複gather[0,0,2]とscalar broadcastを含みます。wide写像と固定Bratu状態はサイズ7/31。Euclidean pullbackと指定SPD計量の随伴を区別します。 Independent Jacobians, JVPs and VJPs of discrete nonlinear maps Jv=Df(x)v,\quad \operatorname{VJP}(w)=J^\top w,\quad (Jv)^\top G_yw=v^\top G_x(G_x^{-1}J^\top G_yw). The fixed R4-to-R3 map includes repeated-index gather[0,0,2] and scalar broadcast. Wide maps and fixed Bratu states have sizes 7 and 31.
